title: Continuity hand-off: a fresh session resumes from the record alone

completion_criteria.text: Declared session focus does not exist anywhere in the record, the briefing, the tools or the preflight procedure.
completion_criteria.check: git grep -n focus src/domain/pointer.ts src/render/briefing.ts src/server/tools/ returns nothing

completion_criteria.text: A thread record can hold what the work has landed, and can mark an artifact or a risk removed without deleting it.
The stop gate blocks at end of turn unless ledger movement touched the thread this session holds; an unreadable git clears it.
An artifact written on one machine survives a sync, and one removed on either side never comes back.
completion_criteria.check: node --test test/unit/field-merge.test.ts exits 0 with the artifact and tombstone cases present

completion_criteria.text: A session can point a thread at the documents it needs, and can record what it landed and the single next action.
A resuming session is shown what landed, what to do next and the route; retired artifacts and risks render nowhere.
completion_criteria.check: node --test test/unit/briefing.test.ts exits 0 with the landed and retired cases present

completion_criteria.text: The debrief procedure produces a hand-off specific enough that a fresh session begins work without re-deriving anything.
